text: Workers still re-plan filesystem-dependent inputs from argv. (a) `digest --diff <file>` missing at parent plan time → parent plans `Failed`, `Failed` drops the job's READS with its writes, so D2.4 never sees `<file>` and admission does not count it; a worker re-plans, finds the file another batch wrote, runs a view nobody admitted and reads another job's output. On dc6df5a1 the same manifest exited 3: regression. (b) An existing diff file is read twice (parent and worker): a FIFO given once blocks the second read. Fix: the worker must not re-decide anything the parent decided from the filesystem — hand the parent's read result (bytes or failure) to the worker, as stdin and `changed_is_file` already are; and a `Failed` plan keeps its reads in the write check, dropping only its writes. Test: two batches, batch 0 `digest … --out foo.diff`, batch 1 `digest … --diff foo.diff`, foo.diff absent at start → exit 3.
